blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `SUPER_ADMIN_GUARD_LOCK_KEY`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

The lock key serializing the last-super-admin check with the removal it
guards, so that concurrent removals can't both pass the check.
